findings.title: mark_failed_threshold renamed without updating any callers or tests
findings.body: This PR renames the previously public function `mark_failed_threshold` (in `sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed`) to `try_incident_threshold` in the new module `sentry.monitors.logic.incidents`, and similarly renames `create_issue_platform_occurrence` to `create_incident_occurrence`. The changed-files list contains only these four files — no test files or other callers are updated. Existing tests in `tests/sentry/monitors/logic/test_mark_failed.py` (which historically exercise `mark_failed_threshold` directly) and any other code importing `mark_failed_threshold` or `create_issue_platform_occurrence` from `sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed` will fail with ImportError after this merges. Either keep backwards-compatible aliases in `mark_failed.py` or update the dependent tests/callers in the same PR.

findings.title: get_monitor_environment_context discards the transformed config copy
findings.body: In `get_monitor_environment_context`, the code copies the monitor config and replaces `schedule_type` with its human-readable display value (`config["schedule_type"] = monitor_environment.monitor.get_schedule_type_display()`), but the returned dict uses the untransformed original: `"config": monitor_environment.monitor.config` instead of `"config": config`. As a result the schedule_type display conversion is dead code and the monitor context sent with the occurrence event still contains the raw integer schedule_type. This defect was carried over verbatim from the old `mark_failed.py`, but since this PR is creating the new canonical module for this logic it should be fixed (return the modified `config` copy) rather than propagated.
